summary_1line: Ayodhya’s citizens and aged brahmins follow Rama into exile, lamenting and pleading for his return while praising his virtue and devotion to dharma.

image_candidates.scene_text: A crowd of grieving citizens runs beside Rama’s chariot leaving Ayodhya, arms outstretched and faces tearful as the prince looks back with compassion.
Elderly brahmins with trembling white heads call out to Rama’s horses, pleading for them to turn back as the chariot pauses on the road.
Brahmins carrying sacred fires and white ceremonial canopies follow Rama, Lakshmana, and Sita walking toward the forest under the open sky.
